      • DBInstanceId

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceId")
public String DBInstanceId

        Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        rm-uf6wjk5****

      • DBProxyEngineType

      • switchTime

        @NameInMap(value="SwitchTime")
public String switchTime

        The specified time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

        If you set UpgradeTime to SpecifyTime, you must specify this parameter.

        example:

        2019-07-10T13:15:12Z

      • targetMinorVersion

        @NameInMap(value="TargetMinorVersion")
public String targetMinorVersion

        The target minor engine version.

        example:

        2.25.9_20251028

      • upgradeTime

        @NameInMap(value="UpgradeTime")
public String upgradeTime

        The time when you want to perform the upgrade. Valid values:

        • MaintainTime (default): The upgrade is performed within the maintenance window.
        • Immediate: The upgrade is performed immediately.
        • SpecifyTime: The upgrade is performed at a specified time.
        example:

        MaintainTime
